summary: Remove the intrusive i in the quoted word kačke
rationale: The cited Turoyo at 29/86 reads b ṣəffe d kačke, without the extra syllable in kačike. The supplied Ritter word list also has kačke, and glossary_lookup search kačike finds only this occurrence. This is an inserted vowel, not a stress, length or clitic-boundary change.
